newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ssangyong in Vietnam energy plant joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong in Vietnam energy plant joint venture.

text.p: South Korea's Ssangyong Corp said on Thursday it has agreed with Korea Heavy Industries and Construction Corp and Vietnam's Vinacoal to form a $400 million joint venture to build a thermo-electric power plant in Thai Nguyen, Vietnam.
The joint venture will demolish an existing, but non-operating facility, and build a 100-megawatt plant powered by coal fuel in its place, a company statement said.
The statement did not give the time frame for the construction.
Ssangyong, the foreign trading unit of Ssangyong Group also agreed with the two partners to jointly promote the construction of a 300-megawatt thermo-electric plant in Uong Bi, Vietnam.
